subject.title: fix(runtime): cancelled workflows no longer continue external commands

question: When cancellation arrives during an in-flight side-effecting command, should Lobster preserve its completed partial results while halting later pipeline stages, or convert the whole run to an error/cancelled envelope?
rationale: The implementation can mechanically stop downstream stages, but the public envelope semantics for a completed side effect plus parent cancellation determine whether callers receive partial results, a cancelled status, or an error.

options.title: Halt with partial results
options.body: Return the definitive completed-send results while marking or halting the run so no later pipeline stage starts.

options.title: Return cancellation error
options.body: Raise cancellation after the in-flight send settles, preventing later stages but requiring callers to recover the completed side-effect result through an error contract.

recommendation.title: Halt with partial results
recommendation.body: Return the definitive completed-send results while marking or halting the run so no later pipeline stage starts.

likelyOwner.reason: The runtime and tool-envelope history makes steipete the strongest available owner for the cross-command cancellation contract.
